text.content:
NCX: Night City's spaceport, still a construction site.

Region: the Outskirts (district R). Was: Morro Rock, the Orbital Air massdriver site
Controlled by: Orbital Air and its construction security; Arasaka as Orbital Air's partner
The feel of it: Hard hats, cargo AVs, fencing, and one finished runway
Notable locations: The Runway, the Launch Site, the Spaceport Causeway, Crew Town
Danger: Corporate. SC 8 (spaceport construction security, Hardened Medium). UC 3

The massdriver dream of 2045 became NCX, approved in 2068, and the Spaceport Causeway reaches it from Downtown. Without a hard hat and a badge, you're trespassing.

Places

  • The Runway. SC 9. Suborbital and long-haul flights; the terminal is a row of prefab buildings and a very expensive bar.
  • The Launch Site. SC 10: Orbital Air Security. The massdriver track, half built.
  • The Causeway. SC 6. Two kilometers of road across the water. One way on, one way off. Easy to block.
  • Crew Town. SC 5. Prefab dorms, bars, a clinic and a betting shop.

Getting There

NCART: Morro Rock Blvd (Star Line); NCX Morro Rock opens in 2072.

Turf

None.

People

  • Ingrid Solheim (Exec 7). Orbital Air's site director.
  • Felix "Gravity" Okafor (Tech 5). Crane operator and smuggler.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.13
